description: Update the mw_diag cookie parser to properly handle URL-encoded cookie values. The current implementation fails to parse cookies when their values contain URL-encoded characters like %3D and %26, which are produced by Next.js's cookie setting mechanism.
functional_requirements: Decode URL-encoded cookie values before parsing them with URLSearchParams
Maintain backward compatibility with existing unencoded cookie formats
Add unit tests that verify parsing works with URL-encoded cookie values matching Next.js's production format
